data.name: Torque Trails: Beyond Limits
data.detailed_description:
Take the wheel and push your driving skills to the limit in Torque Trails: Beyond Limits, a single-player vehicle platforming adventure where precision, timing, and control matter more than raw speed.

Drive a wide variety of vehicles across handcrafted levels filled with moving platforms, dangerous traps, dynamic obstacles, and breathtaking environments. From scorching deserts and volcanic landscapes to futuristic cities, mysterious alien worlds, frozen ruins, and floating islands, every level introduces new challenges that will test your driving abilities.

Diverse Vehicles

No two vehicles feel the same. Take control of off-road buggies, muscle cars, sports cars, pickup trucks, futuristic vehicles, and more as you adapt your driving style to conquer each challenge.

Explore Unique Environments

Every level features a distinct atmosphere and visual style, including:

• Desert Canyons
• Floating Islands
• Futuristic Cities
• Alien Worlds
• Volcanic Landscapes
• Snowy Mountains
• Stormy Forests
• Space Facilities

Each environment presents its own obstacles and driving experience.

Precision Platforming

Success depends on skill, timing, and vehicle control.

Navigate through:

• Moving Platforms
• Rotating Obstacles
• Laser Traps
• Crushing Hazards
• Jump Sections
• Balance Challenges
• Environmental Dangers

Every obstacle is designed to reward careful driving rather than reckless speed.

Progress Through Challenging Levels

Advance through increasingly difficult stages that introduce new mechanics, obstacles, and environments while constantly testing your precision and control.

Features

• 15 handcrafted levels

• 15 unique drivable vehicles

• Diverse environments with unique visual themes

• Precision-focused driving gameplay

• Dynamic moving obstacles and traps

• Multiple vehicle types with distinct handling

• Controller support

• Keyboard and mouse support

• Single-player experience

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: ntel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required for the best experience
